info.name: Customer Entitlement & Support Case API
info.description: Run with `make postman`. The Setup folder resets mock data, so runs repeat.

exec: pm.test("exactly the expected cases", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map(c => c.id).sort()).to.eql(["CS-10231", "CS-10240", "CS-10244"]); });

item.name: List cases, second page has no repeats

exec: pm.test("no overlap with page one", () => { const first = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("firstPageIds"));pm.response.json().data.forEach(c => pm.expect(first).to.not.include(c.id)); });

item.name: Read the case for its ETag

exec: pm.test("verified event carries the request's correlation ID", () => { const trace = "postman-trace-" + pm.collectionVariables.get("escalateTrace");pm.expect(pm.response.json().events.map(e => e.correlationId)).to.include(trace); });

item.name: Token issued for the MCP server is rejected (no passthrough)
Anonymous callers get 401 before any validation
Account outside a restricted caller's book is a 404
Case outside a restricted caller's book is a 404
Malformed JSON is a 400, not a 404 (found by fuzzing)
CSV-only ID ACC-77 isn't a customer (crosswalk)
Conflict between CSV and XML is reported
Escalated cases still count as open

exec: pm.test("includes the escalated case", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map(c => c.id)).to.include("CS-10244"); });
